title: Working in
lede: From Joe Justice's study of Toyota, SpaceX and Tesla: a top-of-day breakdown with the whole group, then small mobs of 3–5 working on the same thing at once. Ideas that don't make the final build still add stimulus and flow.

items.name: Driver
items.text: Live prototyping and iterating: writing the code, shaping the component.

items.name: Scribe
items.text: Annotates the design process and the reasoning so every decision lives in the PR.

items.name: Challenger
items.text: Hunts for flaws in the design and proposes iterations on the iteration.

items.name: Relay
items.text: Holds the overview and keeps the other mobs and the dev leads in the loop.

items.name: Pipeline
items.text: Keeps the "3D printer" running: builds, previews, test data, environment.

items.name: Rotate
items.text: When the driver runs out of steam or flow, the next person takes the keys. Remote mobs share screen and pass the branch.
